from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Convert the 'Sex of respondent, 1979' column to numeric values
df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] = df['Sex of respondent, 1979'].astype(int)

# Separate the data by sex
male_grades = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 1]['Highest grade completed, 1979']
female_grades = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 2]['Highest grade completed, 1979']

# Perform an independent samples t-test
t_statistic, p_value = ttest_ind(male_grades, female_grades)
t_statistic, p_value
